wu: Play 'Find Someone Who...' with past regular verbs: Students walk around asking 'Did you... [watch TV] last weekend?' and write names on a bingo sheet.
wuAlt: Alternative 1: Play 'Verb Charades' with past regular verbs; students guess 'Did you... [play football]?'
Alternative 2: Quick review of last week's 'was/were' with 'Where was I?' game using classroom objects.
pres: Show a picture sequence of 'My Last Christmas' (opening presents, eating dinner, visiting family); model 'I opened a present', 'We ate turkey', 'They visited my grandma'; check understanding with 'What did I do?' questions.
presAlt: Alternative 1: Use a Christmas storybook with regular verbs, stopping to ask 'What happened?'
Alternative 2: Realia with a wrapped box; students unwrap and say 'I opened the box'.
prac: Verb Auction: Teams bid on sentences with correct past regular verbs (-ed) from a list; teacher reads sentences aloud, teams write 'buy' or 'pass' on mini-whiteboards.
pracAlt: Alternative 1: 'Past Tense Dominoes' matching infinitive to past form
Alternative 2: 'Chain Drill' where each student adds one sentence to a story about last Saturday.
ls: Listen to a short audio about 'Christmas in Morocco' (adapted for local context); students fill gaps in a worksheet with -ed verbs (e.g., 'They visited the souk', 'They bought gifts').
re: Christmas Verb Relay: Teams race to write past regular verbs on the board from teacher prompts (e.g., 'What did you do?' 'I played music').
prod: Pair work: Students interview each other about 'My Last Christmas' using 'What did you do?' and write 3 sentences on a Christmas card template.
rw: Read a short text 'Christmas Traditions' and underline all -ed verbs; then write 5 sentences about their own last Christmas using past regular verbs.
st: Read a simple Christmas story 'The Lost Present' with regular verbs; close with 'Today we learned to tell stories about the past with -ed verbs. Thank you, class!'
g: Teams bid on correct past sentences with play money
Match infinitive to past form dominoes
Teams race to write -ed verbs on the board
Ask classmates about past weekend activities
Add sentences to a story about last Saturday
diff: Fast finishers: Draw a comic strip of 'My Last Christmas' with speech bubbles using past verbs
Support learners: Use sentence starters 'I...', 'We...', 'They...' with verb list
hw: Option 1: Write 5 sentences about your last weekend with -ed verbs
Option 2: Interview a family member about their last Christmas and write 3 sentences
Option 3: Complete the 'Christmas in Morocco' worksheet with missing -ed verbs
tip: Use local Christmas references (e.g., 'Christmas in Morocco') to make the theme relatable and build cultural awareness while teaching grammar.
